title: MCP GraphQL Aur Shopify OMS Integration
summary:
Baithak ka kendr GraphQL, REST, MCP, Shopify aur OMS ko jodkar surakshit, parikshaniya aur AI-agent anukool integration banana tha. Team ne authorization, MCP tools, order synchronization, debugging aur production validation ke liye architecture aur implementation approach par charcha ki.

Banibrata Manna ne root queries, edges aur artifacts ke liye custom authorization pattern samjhaya. REST resources ko secure karke inherited ya artifact-level permissions dene ka vichar rakha gaya. Artifact execution khaali hone par authorization samasya ke samadhan ke roop mein har edge ke liye root authorization ke saath alag artifact execution rakhne par charcha hui.

MCP ke madhyam se REST aur GraphQL components ko tools ke roop mein publish karne ka uddeshya AI agents ko production systems se niyantrit tareeke se jodna, query permissions aur cost seemit karna, tatha debugging saral banana hai. Goryana mein ek saptah ke prayog ke baad is approach ko anya systems mein lagu karne ka vichar hai. Lovers Online, Adok aur Mephisto ke GraphQL aur API components ke liye setup ko production mein jodne ke saath vaastavik roop se chalakar validate karna aavashyak maana gaya.

Shopify sandbox, OMS, receiving app aur inventory cycle count ke liye engineering approach par bhi charcha hui. Banibrata Manna ne bataya ki purchase order page par inventory baar-baar fetch ho rahi hai; cycle count ke liye inventory ko ek baar index karke reuse karne aur maujooda UI ko banaye rakhte hue engine ko re-engineer karne ka prastaav diya gaya. Receiving app ko agle hafte tak update karne aur uske baad commits, PR, VR aur deployment ki samiksha ka plan rakha gaya.

Shopify onboarding ko Mocky se simulate karne aur OMS APIs ko MCP server ke madhyam se AI agents ke liye uplabdh karane par sahmati bani. Shopify, OMS aur NetSuite ke liye GQL, SuiteQL aur MCP endpoints ko saath configure karne se Shopify order ID ke aadhar par debugging aur reconciliation saral hogi. Master data access ke liye GQL ko REST par prathamikta di gayi, taaki atyadhik vistarit REST APIs aur anavashyak round-robin calls se bacha ja sake. Shopify connector ke liye MCP file, tools aur resources banane hain; kuch resources aur mapping types ki uplabdhata abhi jaanchni baaki hai.

MCP ko HTTP-aadharit JSON-RPC protocol ke roop mein samjhaya gaya, jisme nirdharit request, response aur schema format ka paalan hota hai. Mock service ke liye MCP wrapper requests ko service map mein badalkar responses ko MCP format mein lautayega, aur ise AI agent ke bina bhi chalaya ja sakta hai. Internal ya local upyog mein API key par aadharit access sambhav maana gaya, jabki client-facing ya SaaS upyog ke liye OAuth aur SSO ki avashyakta abhi spasht nahi hai. Isi karan OAuth sambandhi PR merge nahi ki gayi.

Shopify se OMS order sync, MCP tools aur testing setup ko agle teen din ki prathamikta banaya gaya. Banibrata Manna setup poora karke kam-se-kam order sync aur Shopify-OMS order testing par kaam karenge, jabki sambandhit team design, architecture aur development vishayon par sahayata degi. Shopify aur OMS GraphQL data ke liye MCP tools order debugging, reconciliation aur test validation mein AI agent ki sahayata karenge. NotebookLM sirf testing sample tha, anivarya dependency nahi.
